entities.summary: Jermaine Curtis Johnson II is an American professional football linebacker for the Tennessee Titans of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Georgia Bulldogs and Florida State Seminoles, where he was named the ACC Defensive Player of the Year. He also played junior college football for the Independence Pirates. Johnson was selected by the New York Jets in the first round of the 2022 NFL draft.
